_doc: Building and prop heights in feet (eave-to-ridge overall height), used by generators/lighting.py. A building JSON with its own height_ft wins. Otherwise the first match in by_id_contains, then by_kind, then default. The value inside the [min, max] range is picked deterministically from the entity id. roof_pitch_deg gives gabled roofs (ridge along the long side); 0 = flat top.
